=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md: Phase 3 step 1, "lines ~178–183" for CLAUDE.md §7 "In every final response:" list | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The plan points to the wrong location in CLAUDE.md, so the intended bullet would be inserted into §10 MongoDB Rules instead of §7 Output Requirements.
  WHY: The referenced lines are inside the MongoDB subsection, not the output-requirements section, so following the plan would place the edit in the wrong part of the file.
- docs/ai-tools-future-improvements.md: S1 section, "this would generalise the convention to all 30 phase prompts" and "One-time cost is ~2–4 hours for the 30 prompt files" | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The document overstates the number of phase prompts as 30 when the repo has 26 functional phase prompts, inflating the estimated refactor scope.
  WHY: The quoted count does not match the repository contents, so the effort estimate and scope discussion are both biased upward.
- docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md: Phase 3 step 2, "append a new 'When to use a subagent' subsection after current line 463" in CLAUDE.md | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new subagent subsection would overlap with existing CLAUDE.md §16 Task Delegation rules without stating which guidance takes precedence.
  WHY: The plan adds task-category-based instructions on top of model-tier-based spawn rules, creating conflicting guidance for subagent use.
- docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md: Tests section, "scripts/codex_prompt_assembler.*" | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan cites a prompt assembler script that does not exist in the repository.
  WHY: The actual prompt assembly mechanism is scripts/render_prompt.sh and assemble_reviewer_prompt in scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh, so the reference misdirects verification and future changes.
- docs/ai-tools-future-improvements.md: S1 Con section, "most phase prompts are already short enough (28–276 lines)" | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The stated line-count range is incorrect because at least one prompt is far longer than 276 lines.
  WHY: The repository contains a prompt at 809 lines, so the stated upper bound understates the actual spread and weakens the argument.
- docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md: Phase 5, "current line 22" for prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan points to a non-existent line number in prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt.
  WHY: The file is only 21 lines long, so a tool targeting line 22 would fail even though the intended append-at-EOF edit is clear.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
